what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Thailand, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 272670 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
UNHCR's data has no figure for people displaced inside Thailand.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Patani territory, between the government of Thailand and Patani insurgents, from 2003 to 2025.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Cambodia and Thailand in 2011 and in 2025.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Thailand in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 35000 in 2011 to 272670 in 2025, the main year of displacement in the data.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2025, the same year UCDP records the conflict with Cambodia.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people, so they can be higher than the number of people still displaced at the end of the year.
In 2025 IDMC also recorded 228968 new displacements from disasters, counted separately from conflict.
The sources don't say where inside Thailand people moved to.
